variant: Winlet 400 series: 400CL / 400TL with SHB or DHB boom and HV or HS head (10 configurations)
name: GMV Winlet 400
summary: Modular series of self-propelled glazing robots lifting 315–500 kg, configured from narrow (CL) or wide terrain (TL) tyres, single or double hydraulic telescopic boom and a hydraulic-lift or side-shift head. Made by GMV A/S in Denmark.

germany.statusNote: GMV A/S (Bredsten, Denmark) sells Winlet glazing robots direct, with German-language product pages and a quote form. The Winlet range starts at EUR 24,600 ("Wir bieten Winlet ab: EUR 24.600 an-"); which model this applies to and whether it is net is not stated. No German dealer is named.

sellers.name: GMV A/S
sellers.note: Office and production: Industriparken 1, DK-7182 Bredsten (sales: Sales@gmvas.dk). German quote form on the product page; the Winlet overview page says "Wir bieten Winlet ab: EUR 24.600 an-" without naming the model.

specs.quote: Maximale Hubhöhe: Von 2.573 mm bis 3.190 mm.

specs.label: Telescopic boom
specs.value: single (1 × 500 mm) or double (2 × 500 mm), hydraulic under load
specs.quote: Wählen Sie einen einfachen Teleskopausschub (1 x 500 mm) für eine größere Hubkapazität oder einen doppeltem Ausschub (2 x 500 mm) für eine größere Reichweite.

specs.label: Control
specs.value: MAC multi-axis panel or PSAC panel; radio remote with proportional control optional for MAC
specs.quote: Option für MAC : Funkfernbedienung mit proportionaler Steuerung.

notes: CL = narrow tyres for indoor work; TL = wide tyres for stable outdoor use on varied ground (maker).
Winlet glazing robots have terrain tyres with front-axle drive and hydraulic load movements (range statement).
